marketLayer.title: US Tech & AI Infrastructure Capex
marketLayer.fact: Major US mega-cap tech earnings reveal sustained multi-billion dollar increases in AI infrastructure capital expenditures for Q2, despite mixed short-term margin compression.
marketLayer.inference: Sustained capex spend reinforces long-term order visibility for semiconductor equipment vendors and data center supply chain plays, though software monetization timelines remain under scrutiny.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Monetization pace of enterprise AI applications and potential overcapacity risks in hardware infrastructure.

marketLayer.title: HK Tech & Internet Sector Sentiment
marketLayer.fact: The Hang Seng Tech Index saw increased net inflows via Southbound Stock Connect, led by buying interest in Tencent, Alibaba, and Meituan following supportive domestic regulatory signals.
marketLayer.inference: Institutional capital is reallocating into valuation-depressed Chinese internet leaders, viewing lower regulatory friction and enhanced share buyback programs as key downside buffers.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Sustained domestic consumer spending strength and macro recovery metrics across Mainland China.

marketLayer.title: Federal Reserve Rate Outlook & Global Spreads
marketLayer.fact: US Treasury yields eased slightly following softer labor market data, elevating market probabilities of a Federal Reserve rate cut at the upcoming FOMC meeting.
marketLayer.inference: A lower US interest rate environment generally improves liquidity conditions for emerging market assets and relieves Hong Kong Interbank Offered Rates (HIBOR) pressure.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Potential sticky inflation readings in upcoming CPI releases that could delay the easing cycle.

marketLayer.title: EV Supply Chain & Price Dynamics
marketLayer.fact: New energy vehicle (NEV) leaders in HK and US markets reported rising overseas export volumes alongside domestic price stabilization efforts following months of margin pressure.
marketLayer.inference: Export expansion to Southeast Asia and Latin America is becoming a primary revenue growth engine, offsetting price wars within domestic domestic markets.
marketLayer.keyUncertainty: Evolving trade policies, tariff increases, and localization requirements in European and North American markets.
